purpose: Integrate qualified regular and rare target-discovery biology, authenticated multimodal evidence and existing EMA mechanics without forcing partial RNA to reproduce teacher-private biology.

scientific_model.teacher_state: Z_core ⊕ Z_query ⊕ Z_rel_if_qualified ⊕ Z_reg_shared ⊕ Z_reg_private ⊕ Z_context_private
forbidden_point_target: exact realized ATAC state when not RNA-identifiable
exact realized spatial neighborhood when not RNA-identifiable
scientific_model.principle: The rich teacher may know more than the student; recoverable and unrecoverable state are separated empirically.

foundation_target_binding.C2: Z_rel candidate only if corrected replay keeps C2 active
foundation_target_binding.C6: joint Z_core+Z_query scaffold subject to C1+C3 and C6 increment
foundation_target_binding.C4: joint Z_core+Z_query+Z_rel only if constituents qualify
foundation_target_binding.C5: regulatory specialist only; never foundation rescue

regular_program_modeling.rule: Common, continuous, intermediate-frequency and broadly recurrent biology encoded by a frozen foundation target receives the same post-freeze multimodal reconciliation discipline as rare biology.
regular_program_modeling.freeze_rule: Freeze RNA target geometry/program/state/query/relational definitions before any deciding multimodal outcome is opened.

teacher_behavior.rna_biology_without_privileged_increment: retain qualified RNA biology without inventing privileged state
teacher_behavior.multimodal_falsifier: interpretation failure only; no retrospective target rewrite

source_aware_rare_program_modeling.rule: Program state, prevalence and observation-domain support are separate objects.

teacher_behavior.source_shifted_prevalence: preserve biology but not source prevalence as biological target

student_behavior.teacher_private_multimodal_increment: distributional/uncertainty prediction rather than exact point matching

questions: Does ATAC/regulatory evidence support, sharpen, split or falsify a frozen regular or rare RNA state/program/geometry without redefining it?
For C1/C2/C3/C6/C4, what privileged increment exists beyond the frozen RNA object and its required constituent controls?
Which privileged increments are donor-held-out predictable from RNA?
Are increments robust to depth, detection, source/operator, feature support, query abundance where relevant, and matched/random regulatory controls?

ema_integration.runtime_reuse: Reuse canonical V5 AdamW->successful-update->EMA mechanics; no second EMA engine.
ema_integration.ema_shared_core: EMA stabilizes structurally shared teacher/student modules.
ema_integration.privileged_adapters: ATAC/regulatory/spatial teacher adapters may be teacher-only.
ema_integration.failed_update_rule: no optimizer completion means no EMA advance

loss_family.shared_state_loss: rotation/subspace-aware deterministic matching on recoverable blocks

hard_prohibitions: No exact student matching of teacher-private biology.
No source/operator identity as biological state.
No zero-fill for missing privileged evidence.
No C5/multimodal rescue of failed foundation.
No multimodal retrospective redefinition of frozen regular or rare RNA biology.
No global source-confounded rare1/rare5 prevalence as biology.
No real training authority from this file.
